name: How long does a typical front door frame repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical front door frame repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a front door frame repair depends on the severity and type of damage. Minor repairs, such as filling small cracks or addressing superficial rot, might be completed within a few hours. More extensive issues, like replacing significant sections of a rotted frame or structural repairs, could take one to two days. Factors like weather conditions, material availability, and the complexity of matching existing finishes can also influence the timeline. We aim to complete repairs efficiently while ensuring quality, minimizing disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor repairs can take a few hours, while extensive or structural repairs may require one to two days, depending on damage severity.
